name: Surround Sound Studio
description: Native PS5 homebrew audio testing app for HDMI passthrough and surround-sound diagnostics. Supports Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus including Atmos, DTS, DTS-HD, AAC, Dolby TrueHD and Linear PCM, with speaker tests, 5.1/7.1 sequences, a 3D sound field and DualSense microphone calibration.
author: sainsaji
